commit.subject: LU-20070 kernel: add rhel10.2 server support
commit.message:
LU-20070 kernel: add rhel10.2 server support

Add three ldiskfs patches and a series file for RHEL 10.2 (kernel 6.12):
ext4-add-fstrim-mount-option, ext4-dirdata-lustre-compat, and
ext4-mballoc-for-hybrid.

TLC ticket: TLU-123

Change-Id: I4f7da2801d3821bba2247588cd8f379fd0f13ca5
Signed-off-by: Minh Diep <mdiep@thelustrecollective.com>
